title: Minimalist header — remove the bright stripe

labels.before: The bright stripe and mint tint
labels.after: Separate soft shell and neutral selection

steps.path: The top row in Meadow Mist
steps.headline: The session switcher has a separate, subtler surface; the view switch no longer adds a mint-coloured glow.
steps.changed: The old button gradient stretched across the long switcher and formed the bright stripe. Its new surface is a low-opacity blur behind the dots and session name; the Chat/Terminal selection uses the same neutral glass as nearby buttons.
steps.notice: The full-width header veil remains off, and the Terminal button stays fully visible.
